app.name: Pinwall
error.notFound.title: Page not found
error.notFound.message: There is nothing here. The link may be incomplete, or what it pointed to was moved or deleted.
error.client.title: This request could not be completed
error.server.title: Something went wrong
error.server.message: Pinwall ran into an unexpected problem. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, share the request ID with whoever runs this Pinwall.
auth.passkeyFailed: This passkey could not be verified. Try again.
auth.passkeysUnavailable: Passkeys need Pinwall to run on https or on localhost. Use a password, or set PINWALL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN to an https address.
error.validation: Some fields are missing or invalid.
error.tooLarge: The request body is too large.
error.cursor: This page link is no longer valid. Start from the first page.
auth.invalidToken: The bearer token is invalid, expired or revoked.
auth.accessDenied: Your account does not have access to this Pinwall.
auth.sessionRequired: This needs a browser session; API and OAuth tokens cannot do it.
auth.ownerOnly: Only the built-in owner account can do this.
auth.crossOrigin: Request refused: it came from {{origin}}, but this Pinwall runs at {{expected}}. Open Pinwall at {{expected}}, or set PINWALL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN to the address you use.
log.setupLink: Pinwall has no owner account yet. Open this link within 24 hours to create it: {{url}}
auth.setup.invalidLink: This setup link is invalid or has expired. Restart Pinwall to print a new one in the log.
auth.setup.done: Setup is already complete. Sign in instead.
auth.setup.needCredential: Choose a password, a passkey, or both.
auth.setup.required: Pinwall is not set up yet. Open the setup link printed in the server log.
auth.tokenLimit: You have reached the limit of {{max}} API tokens. Revoke one first.
auth.tokenNotFound: This API token does not exist, or it was already revoked.
auth.lastCredential: You cannot remove your last way to sign in. Add a passkey or a password first.
auth.passkeyNotFound: This passkey does not exist, or it is not yours.
auth.ownRole: You cannot change your own role.
publish.path.absolute: {{path}}: absolute paths are not allowed. Archive the folder's contents with relative paths.
publish.path.dot_segment: {{path}}: path segments "." and ".." are not allowed.
publish.path.backslash: {{path}}: use forward slashes in paths, not backslashes.
publish.path.too_long: {{path}}: paths can be at most {{max}} characters long.
publish.path.duplicate: {{path}} appears more than once. Names that differ only in Unicode normalization count as the same name.
publish.path.reserved: {{path}}: the folder __pinwall/ is reserved for Pinwall.
publish.path.link: {{path}} is a symbolic or hard link, and links are not allowed. Archive the file itself (tar -h follows symlinks).
publish.path.special: {{path}} is a device, FIFO or other special file. Only regular files and folders are allowed.
publish.entry.none: No entry page found. Name the main page index.html or index.md.
publish.limit.max_upload_bytes: The upload is larger than the limit of {{max}} bytes (PINWALL_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES).
publish.limit.max_file_bytes: {{path}} is larger than the per-file limit of {{max}} bytes (PINWALL_MAX_FILE_BYTES).
publish.limit.max_version_bytes: The files add up to more than {{max}} bytes (PINWALL_MAX_VERSION_BYTES).
publish.limit.max_files: The upload has more than {{max}} files (PINWALL_MAX_FILES).
publish.limit.max_expansion_ratio: The archive expands to more than {{max}} times its compressed size (PINWALL_MAX_EXPANSION_RATIO), so it looks like an archive bomb.
publish.limit.max_inline_bytes: The inline files add up to more than {{max}} bytes (PINWALL_MAX_INLINE_BYTES). Use an upload URL instead.
publish.archive.corrupt: The archive is damaged or truncated and could not be read.
publish.archive.zip64: ZIP64 archives are not supported. Send a tar.gz instead: tar -czf - -C <folder> .
publish.archive.zipMethod: {{path}} uses a ZIP compression method other than store or deflate.
publish.archive.encrypted: {{path}} is encrypted, and encrypted archives are not supported.
publish.warning.rootAbsolute: {{file}} refers to {{url}} from the server root, which does not load in single-domain mode. Use a relative path.
